problems.title: Hazelnuts in Three Hollows
problems.problem_text: A squirrel collected some hazelnuts and decided to store them in three hollows. In the first hollow, it put half of the hazelnuts and 2 more hazelnuts. In the second hollow, it put half of the remaining hazelnuts and 4 more hazelnuts. In the third hollow, it put half of the remaining hazelnuts and 5 more hazelnuts. After that, 7 hazelnuts remained. How many hazelnuts did the squirrel collect at the beginning?

solution_steps.prompt: How many hazelnuts were left after the squirrel finished filling all three hollows?
solution_steps.hint: Look at the final sentence of the problem.

solution_steps.prompt: Before the squirrel added 5 extra hazelnuts to the third hollow, how many hazelnuts represented half of the previous amount?
solution_steps.hint: Work backwards: undo subtracting 5 by adding 5.

solution_steps.prompt: If 12 hazelnuts were half of the amount before the third hollow, what was the whole amount?
solution_steps.hint: If one half is 12, two halves make the whole.

solution_steps.prompt: Before the squirrel added 4 extra hazelnuts to the second hollow, how many hazelnuts represented half of the previous amount?
solution_steps.hint: Undo the extra 4 by adding 4 back.

solution_steps.prompt: If 28 hazelnuts were half of the amount before the second hollow, what was the whole amount?
Before the squirrel added 2 extra hazelnuts to the first hollow, how many hazelnuts represented half of the original amount?
solution_steps.hint: Undo the extra 2 by adding 2 back.

solution_steps.prompt: If 58 hazelnuts were half of the original amount, how many hazelnuts were there at the beginning?
solution_steps.hint: Double 58 to recover the original amount.
